semantic.justification: Task173 creates actual core SfxStyleSheetBase/SfxStyleSheetBasePool owners and native style hints, reusing SfxBroadcaster/Listener, IndexedStyleSheets, SfxStyleSheetIterator, registered SfxItemPool ranges and actual SfxItemSet. Preserve original field defaults, stable OUString members, name/parent/follow validation, nonvirtual child rename, optional reindex, mask/hidden/help/usage fields, owned versus borrowed set copy and by-value preview. Pool factories/search/cache/insertion/removal/reparent/copy/assignment/clear and derived/base Dying order follow the represented source. Native lifetime/WeakImplHelper allocation is erased under JS GC; bMySet remains solely for set-copy semantics and explicit destructor boundary, not a refcount manager. Core classes implement no UNO XComponent; component query/dispose extension, presentation/XML and derived SfxStyleSheet/ScStyleSheet remain absent rather than stubbed. Preserve CALC146/150 and core copy owner/creation/replacement quirks CALC152..154. Full document/connected UI/same-model ODS and whole-class/module parity are not claimed. Task174 independent core-first initialization exposed an eager public-facade cycle after adding derived classes. Original style.hxx enum/borrowed declarations move unchanged into style-values.ts; style.ts reexports the same public values/types/classes. Core,index,iterator and derived implementations import their declaration owner rather than a class facade. This preserves all enum values and method bodies without lazy imports,globals,initialization registries or caller ordering requirements. Native stylesheet ownership checkpoint supersedes the earlier GC lifetime erasure: SfxStyleSheetBase_Base is the actual zero-interface WeakImplHelper specialization from include/svl/style.hxx. SfxStyleSheetBase inherits its real strong/weak lifetime; copy construction starts a fresh weak base. Final release dispatches virtual Dispose, deletes owned pSet and destroys strings in reverse member order. Pool Remove keeps actual xP through reparent/broadcast; Clear queries genuine optional XComponent and catches only UNO disposal exceptions. Null pool pointers remain valid for original index QA, while pool-dependent methods keep native dereference preconditions. Native Writer shell/style owners, full presentation/XML/filter/UI remain unfinished. See docs/program/native-style-ownership.md. Native pool ownership checkpoint restores SfxStyleSheetBasePool_Base from include/svl/style.hxx and the original broadcaster plus WeakImplHelper inheritance on one object identity through the existing broadcaster role. Copy starts a fresh weak base and copies broadcaster subscriptions; final strong release dispatches virtual Dispose and original indexed-clear/derived-base Dying order. Item-pool borrowing and original empty-copy CALC150 remain. Actual weak-adapter cases verify pool/style release and source survival, without a new lifetime manager.
